androidReleaseNotes: THIS UPDATE MUST BE INSTALLED MANUALLY. UNINSTALL PLIX AND REINSTALL FROM THE PLIX WEBSITE.
releaseNotes:
- Android Notice: This update requires a manual reinstall on Android devices. Please uninstall your existing Plix app and download the new release from https://plix.jman100.com
- Search Subtitles Modal Timeout & Focus Fix: Prevented media overlay timeout from hiding controls behind the modal during playback, keeping remote focus locked inside the search dialog
- Jellyfin Downloaded Subtitles Matching: Resolved issue where downloaded external subtitles defaulted to Arabic MKV tracks by disabling ExoPlayer internal text tracks and streaming exact subtitle files with MediaSourceId
- Jellyfin Transcoding Fix: Fixed quality transcode source error on Jellyfin media by omitting StartTimeTicks from HLS VOD master manifests to preserve valid segment timestamps
- Watchlist Series-Level Filtering: Restricted Watchlist to top-level series and movies, preventing individual episodes (like FBI S9:E3) from cluttering the watchlist and routing episode watchlist actions to parent shows
- Custom Theme Color Picker Keyboard Navigation: Added dedicated edit mode for hex color input on TV, allowing smooth D-pad navigation across virtual keyboard keys without accidental dismissals
- Live Theme Preview Button Background: Updated theme settings live preview bar button background to dynamically reflect configured Sidebar & Surfaces colors across standard, OLED, and Glass themes
- App Version Bump: v1.8.0 (versionCode 42)
